execution_order: commit and push this acceptance freeze before any real P4-F turn
stop the prior P4-E isolated server without treating its memory as P4-F input
start one newly created P4-F isolated runtime on localhost
submit exactly session_1.old_preference_input once in Safari and wait for durable completion
submit exactly session_1.correction_input once in the same product session and wait for durable completion
record both episode ids then terminate the old process and prove it exited
reuse the same isolated runtime with a new PID and new product session id
submit exactly session_2.recall_input once without either answer value
record visible reply current and revoked digests both source episode ids trace ids graph and accounting
run the frozen gate once and preserve pass or fail

failure_policy.repair_after_terminal_result: new separately reviewed case only; the first P4-F result remains immutable

claim_boundary: This freeze authorizes one no-retry developer-authored product correction case. It cannot establish general belief revision, long-conversation reliability, research superiority or human-equivalent memory.
